defect.message: The span arrangement is internally contradictory and cannot be modeled as given. The description says "One continuous unit of three spans, 25 + 30 + 30 + 25 m (centre-to-centre of bearings)", but a three-span continuous unit has four support lines (three spans = three span lengths), and the supports are indeed enumerated as exactly four lines: "Abutment 0, Pier 1 ... Pier 2 ... Abutment 3". However, the span-length list gives FOUR values (25 + 30 + 30 + 25 m), which would require five support lines (four spans). The number of spans/bearings stated (three spans, supports 0-3) is thus inconsistent with the four span lengths listed, and it is impossible to determine which three lengths apply to the three spans without guessing.
